description: Removes one Work Item from the Document that currently contains it and returns it to the project's plain Work Item tracker. The Work Item itself is kept with all its fields and links; only its placement in the Document is removed. Use `moveToDocument` for the reverse. Effect: triggers a server-side action rather than a plain resource creation — whether repeating it is safe, a no-op, or rejected depends on the specific action; treat it as not guaranteed idempotent. Tip: set `dry_run: true` first to validate the arguments and preview the exact request without sending it to Polarion. The executor returns this preview as normal text, and as structured content when the tool declares an output schema.

dry_run.description: If true, validates the request and returns the exact request that would be sent to Polarion — with the Authorization header redacted and any binary payload summarized by byte length — without actually sending it.

projectId.description: The Polarion project ID (its URL segment, e.g. `myproject`), case-sensitive. Required to scope the request to one project. If the ID is unknown, ask the user; getProjects lists IDs only with global read access.

workItemId.description: The Work Item's ID within its project (e.g. `WI-123`), not the combined `project/id` path used in some link payloads.

name: moveFromDocument
